text: To rotate the gateway API key, generate a new key with `soh key new`, update the client config, then restart the gateway service.
The gateway listens on port 4000 on the loopback interface only; LAN clients need the key and the --lan flag.
Model weights live under the HF cache on the fast external volume; set HF_HOME to move them.
If the external volume is unmounted, downloads fail with a disk floor error rather than filling the internal drive.
The image lane renders a sign and reads the text back with OCR to score character error rate.
Speech is scored by transcribing the generated audio and computing the word error rate against the script.
A screen run uses one small case per lane to prove the pipeline loads before any full measurement.
Adoption requires the challenger to beat the incumbent on the lane metric and a paired sign test at alpha 0.05.
The nightly sweep reads release feeds and the model registry to propose new candidates.
Candidates that need CUDA are declined on Apple Silicon and reopened when a machine with a card reports in.
To free disk space, delete rejected weights with `soh disk --delete rejected`; adopted models are never removed.
The worker runs queued jobs one at a time so two models never load into memory together.
Memory pressure above the ceiling pauses the queue until the machine has enough free unified memory.
The privacy scanner refuses a commit that contains a home directory path or a private hostname.
Reports are published to a public page from the reports branch after a privacy scan.
The music lane generates a song from lyrics and transcribes the vocals to measure sung word error rate.
Video generation on the Studio takes about seven minutes for a short clip, so the lane runs only when named.
The agent lane copies a small repository into a sandbox and runs a hidden test after the model edits it.
Tool calls in the agent lane are refused if a path escapes the sandbox or passes through a symlink.
The decide lane asks for typed decisions and scores accuracy, Brier score and calibration error.
Calibration is measured with expected calibration error once at least one hundred decisions are pooled.
llama-server loads GGUF files by stem and serves them through the router on its own port.
mlx_lm.server swaps to whatever repository the request names, so evaluating two models alternately reloads each time.
A text model's context window is planned from free memory, including the key-value cache at the chosen precision.
Holdout cases are chosen by a hash of the case content so that editing one case leaves the others on their side.
Discovery searches the registry by substring of the repository id, so a query must appear inside the name.
A retest reopens a rejected candidate up to three times over three weeks to catch false negatives.
The launchd agents restart services after a reboot; discovery can be disabled without touching the others.
Windows machines run the same harness with a job object to measure peak memory instead of /usr/bin/time.
The OCR check on Linux uses RapidOCR because tesseract misread most generated signs.
